criteria_verification.notes: Module guardkit/memory/harvest_taxonomy.py exists with HARVEST_MAP defining all required episode types (adr, review_report, feature_outcome, document) with correct directory mappings and markdown format. Evidence confirmed via module import and 36 test collection.

derive_episode_id() implemented with deterministic SHA-256 algorithm returning 'ep-{16-hex}' format, byte-identical to fleet-memory reference. Verified by format tests, determinism tests (same input = same output), and reproducibility tests (100 calls = 1 unique value).
natural_key_for() returns three-segment format 'guardkit:{repo_relative_path}:{episode_type}' as specified. Verified by format tests, path preservation tests, and various episode type tests.

episode_type_for() resolves doc paths to episode types using longest-prefix matching via Path.parts. Automatically excludes transient dirs. Verified by 14 tests covering all mappings, exclusions, nested paths, and edge cases.

All episode types (adr, review_report, feature_outcome, document) validated as NATS-safe subject segments matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]*$ via validate_episode_types() on module import. Verified by NATS pattern tests.

Determinism verified by TestEndToEndDeterminism class with 5 tests: same path yields same ID (3 calls identical), different paths yield different IDs, reproducibility (100 calls = 1 unique value), path sensitivity tests. All passing.

All files are valid Python with correct syntax: module imports successfully, all 36 tests pass, pytest collection succeeds, proper type hints and docstrings, no import/syntax errors. Follows Python best practices.
